subject: Re: Order form: security exhibit and audit scope
messages:
From: Julia Kim <julia.kim@cloudhealthlabs.com>

Cc: Mike Ortiz <mike.ortiz@cloudhealthlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Order form and audit scope - security exhibit questions

Hi Sofia / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the performance you showed. Legal at CloudHealth asked me to surface a few items we need to reconcile in the Order Form security exhibit before we can route to procurement. Attaching a short spreadsheet with our asks (CHL_SecurityReqs_v1.xlsx).

Top items:
- SOC 2: preferred method to receive reports (S3 link with short-lived creds vs secure portal). Also frequency — annual plus on-request evidence?
- Pen test language: we need a defined window to run tests, allowed IP ranges, and a contact for test coordination. Can you confirm Redwood's stance on remote staging vs internal-only test accounts?
- Audit rights / access: our auditors may request temporary read-only access to telemetry for a 2-week window. What level of data export/audit logs can Redwood provide and on what lead time?
- Evidence cadence: prefer a predictable monthly evidence drop for production operational metrics; if not possible, weekly roll-ups.

Can Ben and Sofia propose specific wording or options we can mark up? Mike from Legal is cc'd — he will track the contract redlines.

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Kim
Senior Security Program Manager
CloudHealth Labs

Attachments: CHL_SecurityReqs_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Kim <julia.kim@cloudhealthlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form and audit scope - security exhibit questions

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. I pulled together a short draft of the security exhibit that maps to each ask and included two suggested options where we typically see friction (evidence cadence, and pen test windows). See attached: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_draft_v2.docx.

High-level responses:
- SOC 2 reports: we can provide annual SOC 2 Type II reports via either (a) secure S3 url with time-limited credentials + automated rotation, or (b) upload to a customer portal. For most enterprise customers we enable S3 links plus an on-request portal upload for auditors.
- Evidence cadence: we prefer monthly evidence bundles for production metrics (config changes, deployment logs, control attestations). If you require higher granularity we can do weekly roll-ups for target endpoints — this has a cost/ops implication. Option A (monthly) / Option B (weekly roll-up).
- Pen test: we allow customer-directed pen tests in a named staging environment. Redwood requires notice at least 10 business days before the start date, a point of contact, and agreed IP ranges. We can't provide production DB writes for pen tests; tests should target staging with scrubbed/test data.
- Audit access: we can offer temporary read-only auditor accounts scoped to telemetry and access logs for pre-agreed time windows; audit exports are delivered as gzipped CSVs or via a signed S3 link depending on preference. Turnaround for custom exports is typically 5 business days.

Next steps proposed:
1) Ben to add the pen-test operational constraints and IP allowlist wording.
2) Laura (legal) to review and advise on MSA/order form language for audit rights.
3) If that sounds OK, Julia can send redlines back by EOD Friday and we’ll respond within 48 hours.

Ben/Laura — please see inline comments in the attached.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_draft_v2.docx (document, 78KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Kim <julia.kim@cloudhealthlabs.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Ortiz <mike.ortiz@cloudhealthlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form and audit scope - security exhibit questions

Julia / Sofia — quick follow up from the infra/ops side with concrete pen-test guidance and a sample IP allowlist.

Key operational items for redline:
- Pen-test window: Redwood will allocate a dedicated staging cluster for customer-directed tests. We require a 10 business day notice and a max 5 business day test window unless otherwise agreed.
- Test accounts: we will provision scoped service accounts and synthetic test data; no production credentials will be used.
- Allowed IPs: provide a short list of source IPs for the tester(s). We will add those to the allowlist for the duration of the test window.
- Reporting: test findings may be submitted to security@redwoodinference.com; critical/urgent findings should be reported immediately by phone to the on-call lead.

On evidence delivery: we can publish monthly evidence bundles to an S3 prefix and provide a manifest file; for ad-hoc auditor requests we generate a tarball and supply a short-lived signed URL. Delivery SLA for ad-hoc exports: 5 business days.

I've attached our internal pen-test guidelines that we normally provide to customers — this includes the redaction policy and escalation matrix. If CloudHealth needs a longer test window, we can accommodate but will note it in the order form as an exception.

Ben Carter
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pen-test-guidelines.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Thanks — that all helps. Mike from our legal team reviewed Redwood_Security_Exhibit_draft_v2 and provided a couple of small contract-level redlines in the attached PDF (CHL_OrderForm_Redlines_0629.pdf). Two quick clarifications from our side before we mark up the Order Form formally: 

1) Evidence cadence: we prefer weekly roll-ups for the two production endpoints we care most about (ingest API and inference endpoint). If Redwood can commit to weekly roll-ups for those two items specifically, we can accept monthly for the rest.
2) Pen test window: we’d like to propose a tentative window 2027-07-06 to 2027-07-08 to run initial discovery testing. Can Redwood confirm staging availability for those dates and provide the IP/coordination contact?

We uploaded our redlines to DocuSign and started a review (link below). If Redwood can confirm the weekly roll-ups on target endpoints and the staging booking for 07/06–07/08 by EOD tomorrow, we’ll proceed with the procurement paperwork.

Julia
